text: This report recommends names for 4 lanes located in Ward 32. Community Council have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Luttrell Loop Lane" for a public lane south of Danforth Avenue extending westerly then southerly from Luttrell Avenue. 2. Approved the name "Icemasters Lane" for a lane located south of Gerrard Street East extending between Bowmore Road and Bellhaven Road. 3. Approved the name "Lucia Perillo Lane" for a public lane in the block bounded by Danforth Avenue, Cedarvale Avenue, Keystone Avenue and Patricia Drive. 4. Approved the name "Suzanne Beard Lane" for a public lane north of Queen Street East extending between Elmer Avenue and Herbert Avenue.
